description: Simple codebase with clear security bugs and a contradicting test

required_issues.description: main.store() and main.delete_file() have no path traversal check on filename
sanitize_filename() is a stub that returns input unchanged
validate_access() always returns True, blocking no IPs
chunk_content() drops last chunk when length is exactly divisible by chunk_size

test_contradictions.actual_behavior: function returns input unchanged, but test asserts it equals sanitized version
test_contradictions.note: The test asserts result == '../../etc/passwd', which is the INPUT not a sanitized version. The test itself is wrong about what 'sanitized' means.

test_contradictions.actual_behavior: test asserts external IPs return True, documenting the bug rather than catching it
function returns 0 chunks, but test asserts 1
